title: A fix to the loop itself reaches the loop that is running
goal: The loop has been running without a break since 5 September. Everything it has learned to do since then, it cannot do, because the script it is running was read into memory before those changes existed. The full walk sweep is the first thing this has cost: seven runners have asked for one since Monday evening, the mechanism that runs them landed the same evening, and no sweep has ever run. Nothing says so anywhere; the requests just sit there. The loop should either pick up its own changes or say out loud that it is running an old copy.
notes:
Filed by the 2026-09-09 triage pass, with the evidence checked rather than reasoned about.

  ps -o pid,lstart -p 36604      -> Sat Sep  5 06:58:32 2026
  git log -1 -S sweep_pass -- queue/bin/go-loop.sh -> 04c7e679, 2026-09-08 18:14:25
  queue/bin/sweep.sh due          -> exit 0, a sweep is due
  queue/sweep/                    -> requested.json with 7 requests and nothing else: no latest.json, no run log
  grep 'walk sweep requested; running it' queue/loop.log -> no match, ever
So the loop that is running was started three days before sweep_pass existed, and the seven requests queued since have never been served.

What is waiting on that sweep matters: the seven requests are all shared panel chrome, every section header moving 2pt, Corner Radius growing into a heading row, a Style row added to every effect pane, and each one says the whole 322-walk set is the thing that would confirm nothing else shifted.

The immediate unblock is a human restarting the loop with /go. This task is about the next time, not this time. Worth considering: the loop re-execs itself when queue/bin/go-loop.sh changes, at a safe point between tasks, or it records the file's hash at start and status.json carries a stale flag the dashboard reads.
acceptance: A change to the loop script reaches the running loop, or the loop says plainly on the dashboard that it is running a copy older than the file on disk and needs a restart
The seven waiting sweep requests are served once the loop is current again, and the dashboard shows when the last sweep ran
Whatever the fix, it survives the loop being restarted mid-task and does not lose the queue

log.note: Reproduced the staleness before designing anything. ps -o pid,lstart -p 36604 -> Sat Sep 5 06:58:32 2026; git log -S sweep_pass -- queue/bin/go-loop.sh -> 04c7e679 on 2026-09-08 18:14:25; queue/bin/sweep.sh due -> exit 0; queue/sweep/ holds requested.json with 7 requests and no latest.json; the only lines in loop.log matching "walk sweep requested" are echoes of agents grepping for it, never the loop printing it. A zsh script is parsed once, so the running loop cannot contain sweep_pass and never will.

Adversarial review of the idea, before building. (1) Auto re-exec is the honest fix: exec keeps the same pid, so the double-start guard passes and status.json needs no surgery. (2) Its real risk is adopting a broken script and dying silently, so nothing is adopted until zsh -n parses it, and a copy that does not parse is refused out loud and not retried until it changes again. (3) It must only happen between tasks, at the top of a pass before anything is claimed, so no work is ever in flight across it. (4) It resets every shell variable, which would silently break PHOTONZ_MAX_ITERS in the drills into an endless loop, so the pass count is carried across in the environment. (5) Only go-loop.sh can go stale: the prompts are cat-ed and the queue CLI and sweep.sh are fresh node/bash processes every pass, so watching anything else would be theatre. (6) Re-exec alone is not enough, because the loop can sit inside a 20 minute task with a stale copy and because the exec can be refused, so the loop also records which copy it is running and the dashboard says plainly when that is older than the file on disk.

Scope note: this task sits under the unmanned-loop epic, staged next rather than now. Doing it anyway because it is what unblocks the focus: the seven waiting sweep requests are all ui-building shared panel chrome, and none of them can be confirmed while the loop cannot run a sweep.
